title: Is there a way you've found to consistently go to the mallworld?
content: I've been having dreams about the mall and surrounding areas my whole life, however I haven't found a specific way to go there of my own volition; it's always seemingly random, I never get to decide where I end up. So, I was just wondering if you guys had found a way to do so? I only ask because it's been a while since I've had one (a couple of weeks) and I really want to go back again. I feel... I guess homesick is the word? Just a deep seated longing to go back. I'd also love to actually try and meet people, when I go it feels like I can't totally interact with the creatures or people I see. (Minus one person that I see sporadically, but idk)
